outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with 'Approximately' 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal floods: State Dept. spokesperson; 7 dead after ferry carrying 260 passengers capsizes off Cyprus, officials say; Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific.

items.headline: 'Approximately' 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal floods: State Dept. spokesperson
items.detail: State Department Spokesperson Tommy Pigott said approximately 85 Americans remain missing in Nepal on "This Week."

items.headline: 7 dead after ferry carrying 260 passengers capsizes off Cyprus, officials say
items.detail: A ferry carrying more than 260 people capsized in the Mediterranean Sea off the northern coast of Cyprus on Sunday, local officials said.

items.headline: Tropical Storm Karina strengthens into a hurricane in the Pacific
items.detail: It could become a major storm this week, forecasters say.

items.headline: WATCH: Divers save the day for bride-to-be
items.detail: A group of divers from the Hudson Valley Commercial Diving School happened to be at the restaurant where Denise Rivera dropped her engagement ring into the Hudson River.

items.headline: WATCH: Woman alleges she was ejected from mountain coaster in Colorado
items.detail: A woman alleges she was thrown from her seat, dragged along the tracks and seriously injured as a result.
